ResearchTabDef.label: D'thorga: Submarines
ResearchTabDef.generalDescription: Boats that go under the water, and the gear that lets their crews work and survive there.

ResearchProjectDef.label: submersible hull
ResearchProjectDef.description: A sealed hull with ballast tanks and a battery bank: a boat that can go under the water and come back.

ResearchProjectDef.label: seabed running gear
ResearchProjectDef.description: Retractable wheels that let a submersible rest on the bottom and wait there, using less air and charge and making less noise.

ResearchProjectDef.label: hydrophones
ResearchProjectDef.description: Underwater microphones along the hull, so that a submersible's crew can hear what moves around them, find other boats under the water and know when danger is close, without making a sound.

ResearchProjectDef.label: air purification
ResearchProjectDef.description: Canisters that take the carbon dioxide out of a sealed hull, so that a crew can stay under for longer and suffers more slowly when the air runs out.

ResearchProjectDef.label: marine science
ResearchProjectDef.description: A small laboratory fitted inside a submersible, with seats for two scientists who can carry on the colony's research at sea.

ResearchProjectDef.label: advanced marine science
ResearchProjectDef.description: Samples from the deep, studied before they spoil: an analyser bench for a submersible's laboratory, so it can take on the work of a hi-tech research bench. Only scientists seated in a laboratory aboard can research this, on samples they gather themselves.

ResearchProjectDef.label: active sonar
ResearchProjectDef.description: A transducer that sends a pulse of sound into the water and listens for its echoes, finding what a quiet listener cannot: things keeping still, and boats however quiet. Every ping is heard, and gives the boat away.

ResearchProjectDef.label: faired sensor sail
ResearchProjectDef.description: A submersible's sail rebuilt as one smooth fairing around its sensors, so the water flows past quietly and the arrays hear and reach further, at the cost of deck room.

ResearchProjectDef.label: laboratory hull section
ResearchProjectDef.description: A section of pressure hull let into a submersible amidships to lengthen its laboratory, with room for a third scientist and better equipment, at the cost of speed.
